_comment: Planet parameters. Every field can be overridden on the command line (see --help). world_height must be a power of two and columns_per_face % world_height == 0. vertical_scale null = R / 6,371,000 m (Earth slopes). sea_level is in blocks above the bottom of the world. roughness scales the engine's fine relief (metre to ~50 m texture); landform scales its landforms between the bake's scale and ~50 m (ridges, valley networks, escarpments, mesas; 0 = none).
name: Neisor
